```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
library(tidyverse)
A <- ".."
panel_dir <- file.path(A, "Figures_2026b/Manuscript_panels")
pngs <- list.files(panel_dir, pattern = "\\.png$")
ids <- sub("\\.png$", "", pngs)

# One caption per panel prefix (exact id or prefix shared by several files, e.g. one map per section).
# Test values: Outputs/Manuscript_panels_2026b/tests_cytotrace_mp.csv, Outputs/GloScope_manuscript_2026b/anosim_manuscript_panels.csv.

The shares are in the figure caption.")
figures <- list(
  "Fig. 1" = "^Fig1", "Fig. 2" = "^Fig2", "Fig. 3" = "^Fig3",
  "Suppl. Fig. 3" = "^SFig3", "Suppl. Fig. 4" = "^SFig4", "Suppl. Fig. 5" = "^SFig5", "Suppl. Fig. 6" = "^SFig6",
  "Reviewer" = "^Rev")
stopifnot("a requested panel has no PNG" = all(sapply(captions$prefix, function(p) any(startsWith(ids, p)))),
          "a PNG has no caption" = all(sapply(ids, function(i) any(startsWith(i, captions$prefix)))))

show_figure <- function(rx) {
  cap <- dplyr::filter(captions, grepl(rx, prefix))
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(cap))) {
    files <- sort(pngs[startsWith(ids, cap$prefix[k])])
    cat(sprintf("**%s**. %s\n\n", cap$panel[k], cap$caption[k]))
    for (f in files) cat(sprintf("![](%s){width=100%%}\n\n", file.path(panel_dir, f)))
  }
}
```

Panels of the submitted manuscript, rebuilt on the October 2026 atlas (349,696 cells, 63 libraries, 56 tumours/tissues, 45 patients) with the changes requested on 2026-10-15. Each panel is also available as PDF and PNG in `Figures_2026b/Manuscript_panels/`, named by figure panel.

## Methods

- **Object**: October 2026 reprocessed atlas (`final_Subtyping_iCNV_reclustered.qs2`). Boxplots show one point per tumour/tissue (`orig.ident`); p-values are two-sided Wilcoxon tests on patient means (`Patient_nr`), so a patient with two samples in one group counts once. Groups with fewer than 3 patients are shown but not tested.
- **CytoTRACE2**: scores from `run_cytotrace2_2026b.R`, one library at a time (report 01b). Panels: `manuscript_panels_2026b_cytotrace_mp.R`.
- **Weizmann metaprograms**: the 67 malignant meta-programs (3CA, 2025-01-29) scored with UCell on the 200,634 melanoma cells and melanocytes (`score_3CA_ucell_2026b.R`), as in the submitted figures.
- **GloScope**: divergence matrices of report 03b (k = 50 KNN, symmetrised KL), MDS with `cmdscale`, ANOSIM with 999 permutations (`manuscript_panels_2026b_gloscope.R`). Each divergence value depends only on its two samples, so sub-matrices of the cached matrices were used for the added rows.
- **Spatial**: Xenium 5k, Boston cohort (6 sections) and pUM26 (primary Region5_0038498, liver metastasis Region1_0038471). Stemness = October malignant stemness signature restricted to the panel genes (top/bottom 50); CNV = per-cell RMS of the infercnvpy matrix. Reports 14b/14c.
